$comment: Contract of the UserMenu and MorphNav blocks (DEC-2026-11-18-012). Figma owns the anatomy, Storybook the behaviour and motion.

blocks.name: UserMenu
a11y: Opens from AccountMenuTrigger, which reports aria-expanded
The theme segments are named Light, Dark and System
Sign out is Variant=default: critical is only for actions that delete

blocks.name: MorphNav
a11y: Product opens on pointer enter and from the keyboard; its trigger reports aria-expanded
Search opens on click and Cmd K and takes focus
Escape returns to the bar and restores focus to the control that opened it

Hover intent: the panel waits 60 ms to open and 140 ms to close. Crossing the other bar items (Solutions, Resources, Pricing) never closes it: it closes when the pointer leaves the container, on Escape or on a second click. Those items have no panel in Figma

motion.mechanism: transitions on the container's width and height; the bar stays mounted
motion.reduced: no size travel, the fades stay

motion.mechanism: opacity and rise, row by row after the container starts to grow
motion.reduced: fade only, the rise is neutral in the tokens

motion.mechanism: opacity, all rows together, before the container closes
transitions on the container's width and height
motion.reduced: no size travel, the fades stay
